basic_details.job_title: KVS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for PGT, Primary Teacher Posts
basic_details.short_information: Kendriya Vidyalaya CRPF Saraikhas, Jalandhar (केंद्रीय विद्यालय सीआरपीएफ सरायखास) is preparing a panel of teachers on a purely part-time/contractual basis for session 2026-27, with consolidated pay of 27,500 per month for PGT (English) and 21,250 per month for Primary Teacher (PRT). Candidates must apply online at https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ by 2:00 PM on 1 December 2026. The interview is on 2 December 2026, with reporting at 9:00 AM.

how_to_apply: All willing candidates must apply through the link https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/. The last date to apply online is 2:00 PM on 1 December 2026. The notice does not describe the individual steps of the online form.
Documents named in the notice, to be brought at the time of interview:
Printout of the online application form
One set of self-attested copies of all documents

content_sections.heading: Kendriya Vidyalaya CRPF Saraikhas Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit, the application fee or the minimum educational qualification.

rows.details: PGT (English): consolidated pay 27,500 per month; PRT: consolidated pay 21,250 per month

content_sections.heading: About Kendriya Vidyalaya CRPF Saraikhas
content_sections.text: Kendriya Vidyalaya CRPF Saraikhas is a school at Saraikhas, Jalandhar-144805. Its notice gives CBSE Affiliation No. 1600041. The notice is signed by Dr. Bhushan Kumar, Principal.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Pay
content_sections.text: The panel is on a purely part-time/contractual basis for the session 2026-27. Appointment is purely need based. It arises only when regular staff are not available due to long leave, transfer, training etc.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification for either post. It directs interested and eligible candidates to the school website, https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in , for eligibility and other information. Candidates should check the discipline-specific eligibility for PGT (English) and Primary Teacher (PRT) in the official notification and on that website.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kendriya Vidyalaya CRPF Saraikhas Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: All willing candidates must apply through the link https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ . The last date to apply online is 2:00 PM on 1 December 2026. The notice does not describe the individual steps of the online form. Documents named in the notice, to be brought at the time of interview: Printout of the online application form Original documents and certificates One set of self-attested copies of all documents

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview is on 2 December 2026. Reporting time is 9:00 AM and the interview starts at 10:00 AM. A screening test may be conducted to shortlist the candidates before the interview if required. The notice gives no venue other than the school's own address in its heading and no further selection details.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kendriya Vidyalaya CRPF Saraikhas teacher posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 1 December 2026 (01.12.2026), up to 2:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are open?
faq.answer: The notice lists PGT (English) and Primary Teacher (PRT), both on a purely part-time/contractual basis for session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay for PGT (English) and PRT?
faq.answer: PGT (English) gets consolidated pay of 27,500 per month and Primary Teacher (PRT) gets consolidated pay of 21,250 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply through the link https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in/ before 2:00 PM on 1 December 2026. Bring the printout of the online form to the interview.

faq.question: Q5. When is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 2 December 2026. Reporting time is 9:00 AM and the interview starts at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q6. What documents must I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring original documents and certificates, the printout of the online application form and one set of self-attested copies of all documents.

faq.question: Q7. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be a screening test before the interview?
faq.answer: A screening test may be conducted to shortlist the candidates before the interview if required.
